title: NTILE: the SQL standard's buckets, the larger first
description: Of `n` rows in `k` buckets, the first `n % k` buckets hold `⌊n / k⌋ + 1` rows: 10 rows in 3 are 4, 3, 3; in 4 are 3, 3, 2, 2; in 6 are 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1. With more buckets than rows each row gets its own (`ntile(12)` of 10 rows is 1 … 10). Ties and NULLs in the order take buckets by their position.
`ntile(NULL)` is NULL; `ntile(0)` and a negative count raise (`Invalid Input Error: Argument for ntile must be greater than zero`).
reference: The SQL standard's buckets (`ntileOf`, reference-semantics.md, Windows): native on DuckDB. DataFusion spreads the larger buckets out (DF-11).
